parent_objective: instantiate generated controller-profile configs with runtime observation masking and no training
blocked_by: profile configs and runtime masks exist but have not been smoke-instantiated together across all profiles
supersedes: assuming generated configs are runnable because unit tests pass
invalidates: starting profile training before all generated configs instantiate cleanly with runtime mask handling

public_gates: M1192 may instantiate envs, wrappers, and ActorCritic models for generated profile configs
M1192 must not train controller weights
M1192 must not run candidate replay
M1192 must not use private holdout
M1192 must not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not claim controller performance from smoke instantiation

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: checks that generated configs runtime masks envs and ActorCritic profiles instantiate together before training
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: infrastructure smoke only; no training replay PPO promotion private-holdout driver-performance recurrent-belief or paper-result claim
stop_condition: stop if any generated config fails runtime instantiation
stop if L0 reset/step observations are not masked
stop if smoke starts training or PPO
stop if hidden or oracle actor inputs appear
fallback_plan: if a profile fails instantiation, route to focused profile/config repair
if L2_window_100 is too large for smoke model instantiation, keep config but mark training staged with explicit reason
if reset-control needs separate hidden-state runtime, keep it metadata-only and route to reset-control wrapper design
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1191 runtime mask support is ready and generated configs need integrated smoke verification

admission_evidence: M1191 runtime mask wrapper tests pass
training remains blocked until integrated smoke passes
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: L0 runtime mask is observed in smoke artifact
summary reports no training or PPO
next training-smoke design or controller split design is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1192 is infrastructure smoke and preserves L0/L1 controls for later current-frame substitution tests.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1192 instantiates finite-window profiles but does not evaluate temporal evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If runtime smoke fails, route to focused profile/config/runtime repair before training.
allowed_claims: no self-identification, driver capability, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: Generated L0/L1/L2/L3 configs can instantiate with runtime mask handling and no hidden/oracle actor inputs before training starts.
success_criteria: L0 reset and step observations are masked
summary reports training_started false and ppo_used false
no controller training, candidate replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input contract change occurs
failure_criteria: L0 runtime mask is not observed
hidden or oracle actor inputs are introduced

commands.name: run_profile_runtime_smoke
commands.command: instantiate generated profile configs with runtime masks and write smoke artifact without training

decision_rule: M1192 passes if integrated runtime smoke instantiates all generated profiles and observes L0 masking without training.
